SELECT d.doctor, COALESCE(reg.visitCount, 0) AS visitCount, COALESCE(bill.patientCount, 0) AS patientCount, COALESCE(bill.prescriptionCount, 0) AS prescriptionCount,
ROUND(COALESCE(bill.prescriptionFee, 0), 2) AS prescriptionFee, ROUND(COALESCE(sales.actualTotal, 0), 2) AS actualAmount, ROUND(COALESCE(sales.costTotal, 0), 2) AS totalCost, ROUND(COALESCE(sales.actualTotal, 0) - COALESCE(sales.costTotal, 0), 2) AS totalProfit,
ROUND(COALESCE(bill.westernDrugFee, 0), 2) AS westernDrugFee, ROUND(COALESCE(bill.chineseHerbalFee, 0), 2) AS chineseHerbalFee, ROUND(COALESCE(bill.chinesePatentFee, 0), 2) AS chinesePatentFee, ROUND(COALESCE(bill.treatmentFee, 0), 2) AS treatmentFee, ROUND(COALESCE(bill.consultFee, 0), 2) AS consultFee, ROUND(COALESCE(bill.materialFee, 0), 2) AS materialFee, ROUND(COALESCE(bill.otherFee, 0), 2) AS otherFee, ROUND(COALESCE(bill.additionalFee, 0), 2) AS additionalFee FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT doctor FROM bq_registration WHERE deleted = 0
AND doctor = #{doctor}
) d LEFT JOIN (
SELECT doctor, COUNT(*) AS visitCount FROM bq_registration WHERE deleted = 0 AND orderTime >= #{startTime} AND orderTime <= #{endTime} GROUP BY doctor ) reg ON reg.doctor = d.doctor LEFT JOIN (
SELECT doctor, COUNT(DISTINCT patientName) AS patientCount, COUNT(*) AS prescriptionCount, SUM(amount) AS prescriptionFee, SUM(CASE WHEN typeString LIKE '%西药%' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS westernDrugFee, SUM(CASE WHEN typeString LIKE '%中草药%' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS chineseHerbalFee, SUM(CASE WHEN typeString LIKE '%中成药%' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS chinesePatentFee, SUM(CASE WHEN typeString LIKE '%治疗%' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS treatmentFee, SUM(CASE WHEN typeString LIKE '%诊查%' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS consultFee, SUM(CASE WHEN typeString LIKE '%材料%' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS materialFee, SUM(CASE WHEN typeString LIKE '%其他%' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS otherFee, SUM(CASE WHEN typeString LIKE '%附加%' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS additionalFee FROM bq_bill_not_charged WHERE deleted = 0 AND visitTime >= #{startTime} AND visitTime <= #{endTime} GROUP BY doctor ) bill ON bill.doctor = d.doctor LEFT JOIN (
SELECT operatorPerson, SUM(actualAmount) AS actualTotal, SUM(amount - actualAmount) AS costTotal FROM bq_drug_sales WHERE deleted = 0 AND created >= #{startTime} AND created <= #{endTime} GROUP BY operatorPerson ) sales ON sales.operatorPerson = d.doctor ORDER BY d.doctor
